labels.en: EUDAMED Medical Device and IVD Safety Ontology

comments.en: Ontology modeling the European catalogue of high-risk medical devices and in vitro diagnostics under MDR (EU 2017/745) and IVDR (EU 2017/746), including devices, manufacturers, risks, incidents and field safety corrective actions (FSCA).
